🗼 MY SUMMER TRIP TO TOKYO

From Nagoya to Tokyo for about 2,000 yen by night bus 🚌

💴 Just 2,000 Yen

Now, you can go from Nagoya to Tokyo for only about 2,000 yen.

How did I go? By night bus.

If you use a night bus, you can go for about 2,000 yen.

🗼 From Sakae

The bus leaves from Sakae in Nagoya.

You get on the bus around the front of the TV tower.

🌙 Midnight To 5:30

It leaves at about midnight and arrives in Tokyo at about 5:30 in the morning.

🅿️ 2 Rest Stops

The night bus from Nagoya to Tokyo stops at a parking area about 2 times.

🚻 Cheap Bus

This time, I went on a very cheap 2,000 yen night bus.

Probably, a night bus that costs 3,000 or 4,000 yen has a toilet on the bus.

😴 Sleep And Wake

And then, we arrive at Tokyo Station early in the morning.

🗼 Hello Tokyo

Like this, you sleep, wake up, and you have already arrived in Tokyo.
